nodes.label: validate() system rules
nodes.rationale: Regexes accept impossible types intentionally so validate can explain why (two Observers, repeated animals, wrong first animal), with a final GRID_ROWS lookup covering everything.

nodes.label: Coin / toggle (nullable binary question)
nodes.rationale: User wants to be able to deselect any toggle back to null/X rather than forcing everything defined.

nodes.label: Savior function pair (32 pairs from 5 axes)
nodes.norm_label: savior function pair (32 pairs from 5 axes)

nodes.label: MBTI code derivation (I/E from 1st Savior, J/P from primary axis)
nodes.norm_label: mbti code derivation (i/e from 1st savior, j/p from primary axis)
nodes.rationale: Corrected 2026-10-25: using last animal gave ENTJ for Ni/Te. MBTI I/E differs from OPS coin 9, so a type can be INFJ and OPS-extraverted. J/P rule (Oi->J, Oe->P, Di->P, De->J) matches the grid legend and works for Sleep/Play.

nodes.label: OPS I/E from last animal rule
nodes.norm_label: ops i/e from last animal rule
nodes.rationale: Last animal Blast or Play => Introverted, Sleep or Consume => Extroverted; confirmed by user and original PDF.

nodes.label: Modality order [S M/F][De M/F]
nodes.rationale: Confirmed by user 2026-10-24/25: weak/strong = S axis (1st letter), cat/dog = De axis (2nd letter); checklist tests were inverted and fixed.

nodes.label: Info/Energy e4/i4 class inversion
nodes.rationale: Names inherited from source site are counterintuitive: class e4 = Info, i4 = Energy; verified.

nodes.label: Port 5173 conflict with troppo Docker stack
nodes.norm_label: port 5173 conflict with troppo docker stack

nodes.label: Vite base /OPS-elimination-tool/
nodes.rationale: Required for GitHub Pages publishing; do not remove even if inconvenient in dev.

nodes.label: Function-stack molecule diagram spec
nodes.rationale: Filled disc = introverted, ring = extraverted; Savior/Demon by size and opacity (Claude's proposal, pending user confirmation).

nodes.label: Function letter colors exception (--fn-n/s/t/f)
nodes.rationale: Approved 2026-10-24 exception to the red palette, only for function nodes; F red differs from UI accent on purpose; i/e orientation does not change color.

nodes.label: Monochrome red palette (#b53241)
nodes.rationale: User explicitly asked for no green or other accent colors; monospace font imitating Claude Code's design language; vertical compression.

nodes.label: User workflow preferences (visual check, manual git push)
nodes.norm_label: user workflow preferences (visual check, manual git push)
nodes.rationale: Screenshot via built-in browser before accepting changes; push to git only on explicit request.

nodes.label: Legacy FastAPI backend (fractal generator)
nodes.rationale: Kept from a previous project in case it is resumed; the current frontend does not use it.

nodes.label: editBinary fixed-position binary editing
nodes.rationale: Deleting leaves X without shifting digits; field has no maxLength on purpose so overwriting works.

nodes.label: readPaste strict-then-tolerant paste dispatch
nodes.rationale: Text matching SHORT_CODE/LONG_CODE goes through parse+validate and never falls back to the tolerant parser, which used to load a different type.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules
nodes.rationale: Query the knowledge graph (query/path/explain) before raw grep/reads to get scoped subgraphs; run graphify update after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected and not churn.

nodes.label: CognitiveNotes project (reading content author)
nodes.rationale: Division of work: CognitiveNotes writes the card content, this app owns regex, parser, validator, tab and diagram.

nodes.label: LONG_CODE regex
nodes.rationale: No /i flag so it behaves like the short regex and avoids post-match normalization.

nodes.label: Long form (11 coins)
nodes.rationale: Long form derives entirely from the short form, so the short form is the single source of truth via toLong().

nodes.label: SHORT_CODE regex
nodes.rationale: Optional MBTI prefix needed because the copy button prepends MBTI; strict on purpose (no _, lowercase or headers without parentheses).

nodes.label: Base test case MF-Ni/Fe-BP/C(S)
nodes.rationale: Expected: INFJ MF-Ni/Fe-BP/C(S), binary 10010001101, long form O/De/Oi/N/F/P/B/INFO/E/M-S/F-De; MBTI INFJ but OPS coin 9 E.
